column1: # The games' graphics library as the renderer meets it (docs/RECOMPILATION_PLAN.md §11.1, step 4's step 1): each function's
# Omega Ruby and X addresses (X's from symbols/shared_functions.tsv: identical, or a "call"/"repeated" pair), its name
# (Pomegrade's where it had one, corrected where read otherwise; ours otherwise), its role, what the renderer does with it,
# and how the role is known: traced (the GPU trace, HOS_GPU_TRACE), read (its code, Ghidra), or inferred.
# action: replace (our C in its place calls the renderer), input (its records are read by the renderer, the function kept),
# helper (kept: the replaced ones call it, or nothing needs it once they are replaced), to read (not yet understood).

column4: role
walks a scene tree: each node's virtual at +0x74, then its children (+0x14 list)

draws a 2D quad node (a layout pane or billboard: texture +0xE0, colours +0xD8 / +0xDC, matrix +0x80): builds its state when changed (+0xFE), then submits its built buffer (+0x100) with its material (+0x104)
a node's draw state: default state, textures, its state block (+0xD4, count +0xFA), then the command list
a node's command buffer, built once: draw items grouped by draw record, their two vec4 constants batched 25 at a time
the batched constants and draw commands of Gfx_BuildCommandList
an object's 3x4 matrix and constants into the batch's uniform staging, flushing on a texture change
the batch's uniforms, then one draw of count x 6 indexes
a quad node's draw with its 2D layout part (+0xD8, +0xDC), through 0x337F6C
a layout part's commands (uniforms, draw)
a batch's extra vec4 uniforms
texture unit commands between draws
combiner state between draws
vertex shader uniforms each frame (matrices)
vertex shader uniforms each frame (to read: lights, inferred)
vertex shader uniforms each frame (to read: camera, inferred)
a 48-byte copy (a 3x4 matrix)
a 4x4 matrix into a uniform upload command (components reversed)
a 3x4 matrix into a uniform upload command
rasterizer and output state each frame (viewport, framebuffer)
output state each frame (blending, framebuffer)
the C library's byte-exact copy (any alignment); the H3D runtime copies the BCH's precompiled command blocks with it (the trace credited it, its callers below are the authors)

one submesh's draw: kind 0x10000001 (model mesh): shader (0x2F3F64), mesh state (0x2F529C), material and textures (0x2EC920), then the BCH's draw block (+0x68, size +0x6C); kind 0x10000002: its own block, then uniform uploads (0x80000006 / 0x80000019 headers: 3x4 and 4x4 matrices, vec4 constants) built here
the shader when changed: program state (0x2F5DE8), default state restored after a geometry shader (0x2F3ED8), then the material's virtual +0xC
the shader of the other submesh kind: default state when owed (0x31A9D8), 0x2F3F64 unless both shaders share flag 0x20

the BCH's shader program block (+0x38, size +0x3C) when the program changes, then the shader's own block (+0x7C, size +0x80); collects the boolean uniforms into the state (+0x14, +0x2C for the geometry shader)
the mesh's block (+0x60, size +0x64) and its 0x30 inline bytes (+0x30), then its two flags (+0x2C) into the state
the material's uniforms (0x80000006 header), its matrix (0x80000019) when no skin, then per pass 0x2F406C
the combiner words (6, 0x1237BC; 6 more with a geometry shader), then each enabled texture's BCH block (+0x18, size +0x1C)
a fixed 0x170-byte block of default state (after a geometry shader, or when owed)
a lookup table into slot N when it changed (header from the slot, then the BCH's table block)
scene state each frame: fog (float24 conversion), lights and their tables (614 lines, only skimmed)
a 24-byte copy (6 command words) returning the advanced pointers
an unrolled copy by 32 bytes with preloads
the C library's copy (unaligned head, then 0x144D28)
the copy's aligned part (ldm / stm by 32 bytes)
a BCH used in place: header checked, relocated, materials' uniforms set up
per material: uniforms found by name, the shader programs' upload and configuration lists
a model instance: mesh buffers, visibility, animation channels, material records
a material's 0x174-byte runtime record: its combiner stages, writable (material animation)
a material's standard uniforms by name: WrldMtx NormMtx ProjMtx ViewMtx UnivReg LightCt HslGCol HslSCol HslSDir MatAmbi MatDiff
a mesh's bones (3x4 matrices), indexes and flags
the shader programs' code and operand descriptors (Pomegrade's Gfx_BuildShadowCommandList: not shadows)
the shader programs' configuration and entry points (variants 0 and 1)
